general.subject: General EmailOps Feedback
general.body:
Thanks for taking a minute — answer whatever's easy and ignore the rest.

What were you trying to get done in EmailOps?

What got in your way, if anything?

If you used the AI (chat, classification, drafts) — was it useful, useless, or wrong? An example helps.

If you could change one thing, what would it be?

Honestly: how would you feel if EmailOps disappeared tomorrow? (not bothered / a little annoyed / really disappointed)

Can I reply with a follow-up question? (yes / no)

— technical info, helps me debug — delete this if you'd rather not share —
